fixed.summary: A primary ActionButton's label and icon draw in `accent-fg` on its accent disc (17:1 in the default pack's dark scheme). They read `data-primary:` on themselves, but only the disc carries `data-primary`, so they kept `fg`, near-white on the light accent (1.4:1). The ink is now set on the disc and inherited, and the face's sheen follows the disc through `group-data-primary/disc:`, at 30% white so a dark accent (fantasy's red) keeps its white ink above 4.5:1.
